sentence: This project builds tools that use mass spectrometry to find where proteins are modified, to better understand cell processes including Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how the brain coordinates long term plans with moment to moment adjustments during behavior.
This project makes animal models of rare genetic diseases to help find the causes of diseases that remain undiagnosed.
This project provides computing and data analysis tools that support cancer research, including work with clinical data and cancer patient digital twins.
This project develops non-invasive ways to detect early gene expression changes in retinal ganglion cells in glaucoma.
This project builds structural support for cancer research that aims to reduce cancer.
This project studies how microbes in the human gut affect the way the body handles amino acids and glucose in Type 2 diabetes.
This project studies how a growth factor and glucocorticoids given before birth affect the gut, liver and metabolism of preterm pigs.
This project builds instruments and data analysis methods to track brain chemicals in an animal model of cocaine use disorder.
This project offers magnetic resonance imaging and positron emission tomography to study renal cell carcinoma in animal models and patients.
This project aims to advance the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of mental illness.
This project studies how breast stem cells take part in the early stages of breast cancer development.
This project studies the proteins of human cytomegalovirus that let the virus enter host cells.
This project tests compounds that target polyploid giant cancer cells and uses deep learning to detect them in breast cancer treatment resistance.
This project studies how small RNA molecules in sperm called microRNAs control genes in early embryos and mouse embryonic stem cells.
This project builds a tool to help adolescents with type 1 diabetes use advanced diabetes technology to manage their condition.
This project tests whether endurance training changes a distinct type of fat cell in abdominal fat tissue of adults with obesity.
This project studies how Burkholderia pseudomallei infects the lungs and how the host responds in mouse models of melioidosis.
This project builds an artificial intelligence system to help with HIV care.
This project studies the proteins and metabolism of leukemic cells to understand outcomes in acute myeloid leukemia in children.
